title: tier-2 shipped code: zlib CRC32 name hash against FUN_141b52ca0
notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-tank/src/material.rs, built by cargo and called by crates/ow-tank/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the crc32_seeded entry.

Oracle is FUN_141b52ca0 at exe 0x141b52ca0 (v2b 0x7ff7c6872ca0): uint (byte *data, uint len, uint initial). It is the standard reflected zlib CRC32 with polynomial 0xEDB88320 and table at exe 0x143283ce0 (v2b 0x7ff7c7fa3ce0, 0x400 bytes); initial is complemented on entry and the result on return.

FUN_141bb9810 is the client's lazy string wrapper: it calls this function with initial 0 over exactly the string length, with no NUL terminator. CRC32("basecolor") = 0xad10f602 is the input hash of the pinned material texture record.
The fixture pads every pointee to 64 bytes; bytes past len are present but must not affect either side.
acknowledgedGaps: The client's length parameter is a uint. The probe casts the u64 wire slot through u32 to match it, but the fixture only supplies lengths 0..64, so the rest of the u32 domain and the >2^32 truncation are untested.
